gloss: for children; children's; aimed at children

definitions.gloss: for children; children's; aimed at children
definitions.explanation: Designed or intended for school-age children, roughly ages 6-12. Used to describe books, programs, facilities, and events targeting this age group.

examples.japanese: {児童向|じどうむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read many books for children.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{児童向|じどうむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This program is made for children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{児童向|じどうむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧や⟦{児童文学|じどうぶんがく}→児童文学：22685_jidoubungaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揃|そろ}っている→揃う：01953_sorou⟧。
examples.english: On the second floor of the library there is a children's section, with a rich collection of picture books and children's literature.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧ (child, school-age child) and ⟦{向|む}け→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧ (aimed at, intended for). ⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧ specifically refers to children of elementary school age, as opposed to ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧ (toddlers/preschoolers) or ⟦{青少年|せいしょうねん}→青少年：16559_seishounen⟧ (youth/teenagers).

- {児童向|じどうむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧: teaching materials for children
- {児童向|じどうむ}け⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: facilities for children
- {児童向|じどうむ}け⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: children's program
- {児童向|じどうむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワークショップ→ワークショップ：06399_waakushoppu⟧: workshop for children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {子|こ}ども{向|む}け: for children — more casual and broader in age range
- ⟦{幼児向|ようじむ}け→幼児向け：26433_youjimuke⟧: for toddlers/young children — targets younger children (roughly 0-5)
- ⟦{家族向|かぞくむ}け→家族向け：25175_kazokumuke⟧: for families — broader, includes adults and children together
